title: Casio Unisex Vintage Watch AQ-240EG-9ADF
description:
Give your retro style a modern twist, or your contemporary fashion a vintage touch. Either way you go, the refined and flowy AQ-240E strikes the right chord.

The analog-digital AQ-240 with dual display goes retro-modern. With a slightly rectangular face offset by a gently rounded case and soft metal curves, this watch exudes sophistication.

The sun-ray finish on the dial catches the light with a lustrous glow. Metallic indexes that blend a vintage feel with a modern aesthetic add another eye-catching touch.

The digital LCD at the 6 o’clock position offers outstanding readability while maintaining a harmonious overall design, creating a timepiece that’s both functional and beautiful.
features: Digital: Hour, minute, second, pm, month, date, day
